driver: owned Node SDK worker, one marker-plus-file-read ladder; the worker wire is captured raw
prompt: plant LANTERN-1121, then read data-0..13.txt fully (1500 lines each), then recall the marker
compaction-ladder.ndjson: excerpt of the 3584540-byte raw ladder capture: every opened/receipt/turn-end record, all 15 usage records, and the ladder's final assistant message, all byte-identical and in source order; the bulk text-delta, tool_call and earlier SAVED assistant records are omitted as bulk. The raw capture stays in the evidence tree.
compaction-ladder.stderr.txt: configured values redacted with original-length markers (registered hook event names, ruleCount, skillCount) per the AGENTS.md fixture convention; every other line byte-identical
compaction-later-recall.ndjson: promoted byte-identically from the separate resumed worker process; hand-scanned for operator agent configuration - none present

facts.trigger: input tokens peak at ~1.01M (turns 4 and 7) and ~730k (turns 10 and 13), dropping back to ~325k after each peak: the native agent replaced older history automatically
facts.laterProcess: a separate worker process resumed the agent and answered exactly LANTERN-1121
facts.streamSilence: the SDK run stream carries no compaction or summary record; the evidence is the usage shape plus cross-process marker recall, matching the CLI-era method

limitations: Synthetic file reads at native defaults; the SDK surface exposes no threshold override; no full-capacity or lossless-recall claim. Replacement contents were not inspected.
